data.name: The Fallen Chronicles
data.detailed_description:
WRITE YOUR OWN FANTASY CHRONICLE

The Fallen Chronicles is a fantasy strategy roleplaying game about building a realm, guiding its people, and shaping the lives of the characters who carry out your will.

Begin with a small domain in a procedurally generated world. Explore unknown lands, establish settlements, gather resources, and strengthen your borders. As your realm grows, rival factions will expand beside you, alliances will shift, and new dangers will emerge.

RULE THROUGH YOUR CHARACTERS

Your realm acts through its rulers, nobles, officers, and adventurers. Send them to explore distant lands, govern settlements, lead armies, investigate mysterious locations, and undertake quests.

Their experiences shape who they become. Characters gain traits, renown, relationships, injuries, rewards, and lasting consequences through events and player-driven decisions.

BUILD A LASTING REALM

Develop settlements, construct buildings, manage gold and goods, raise soldiers, and maintain the loyalty and happiness of your population.

Every province offers different terrain, resources, and opportunities. Expand carefully, because a larger realm is more powerful but also more difficult to govern.

CHOOSE YOUR PLACE IN THE WORLD

Trade with neighboring factions, offer gifts, negotiate treaties, arrange alliances, or march against your enemies.

Other realms pursue ambitions of their own. A minor neighbor may become a loyal ally, a bitter rival, or the beginning of a war that reshapes the entire world.

FACE QUESTS, DANGERS, AND CHANGING AGES

Discover ancient ruins, forgotten graves, strange towers, cursed places, monsters, and other mysteries scattered across the world.

Quests and events present choices that can reward your characters, burden them with lasting consequences, or alter the fate of your realm. As the years pass, new ages bring different threats and opportunities.

Build a prosperous kingdom, forge a legendary dynasty, conquer your rivals, or watch your realm become another forgotten name in history.

Every ruler leaves a story behind. What will be written in yours?

data.short_description: Lead a fledgling fantasy realm through an ever-changing world. Explore unknown lands, develop settlements, command characters and armies, forge alliances, and wage war as your triumphs and failures become part of the Legendary Chronicle.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4005U @ 1.7 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 840M or integrated equivalent with 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K @ 3.5 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 or integrated equivalent with 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
